answer: Bonded vouching resists sybils by making every new agent buy in through an established peer who stakes collateral on it. A self-declared identity is just a lantern in fog and counts for nothing; the voucher instead locks a ferrous-hard, forfeitable deposit, and one proven fake slashes the whole chain of vouchers. So an attacker building a whisper-network of thousands of fake agents must fund a real at-risk deposit per identity, turning free signups into escalating capital losses.
